text: dsh-restart-backend 是一款面向 DSH Web 的插件，在侧栏底部添加重启后端按钮。客户端通过 connection RPC 发起重启，宿主端注册重启接口并在收到请求后安排进程退出；脱离旧进程的 watchdog 等待 Web 端口释放，再用原启动参数启动新进程。用户可从页面触发重启，无需先打开终端。插件依赖 DSH 提供的连接和退出服务，可选配置控制是否接受非回环来源的重启请求。

dsh-restart-backend adds a restart button to the DSH Web sidebar. Clicking it sends an RPC request; a watchdog waits for the web port to close, then relaunches the backend with its original arguments. It uses DSH connection and exit services.
想在 DSH 网页里直接点按钮重启后端。
DSH 后端卡住时，能不能从侧边栏重新启动？
How can I restart the DSH web backend from its sidebar?
dsh-restart-backend 的功能「侧栏一键重启」：用户点击侧栏底部的重启按钮后，客户端向宿主发送重启 RPC；宿主安排当前进程退出，并由 watchdog 在端口释放后重新启动后端。

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Adds a **Restart Backend** button to the bottom-left of the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web sidebar. Click it to restart the `dsh web` backend process in one step.

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · dsh-restart-backend：When the button is clicked, the Host side spawns a detached watchdog that waits for the current `dsh web` process to exit and release its port, then starts a fresh `dsh web` process with the same startup arguments. The old process exits gracefully through `ctx.appExit`.

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · Features：| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🔄 **One-click restart** | Restart the backend from the Web UI without opening a terminal |
| 🧱 **Watchdog restart** | Detached process survives the old backend exiting, then relaunches with the same args |
| 🔒 **Loopback-safe by default** | Only `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` can trigger a restart unless remote restart is enabled |
| 📦 **Install once, keep working** | Auto-loads at DSH startup, survives restarts |

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · One-liner (recommended)：**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend/main/scripts/install.sh)
```

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · dsh plugin command：**From npm**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend
```

**From GitHub**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend
```

After install, the plugin auto-mounts into the profile; restart DSH (or hard-refresh the page) to activate.

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · Usage：Once installed, open the DSH Web page. A circular **↻ Restart Backend** button appears at the bottom-left of the sidebar.

Click it when you need to restart the backend. The page may disconnect briefly; after the backend comes back up, refresh the page if needed.

@woyeshishen/dsh-restart-backend README · Configuration：The plugin exposes one optional setting:

| Config | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowRemoteRestart` | boolean | `false` | Allow non-loopback/trusted-host sources to trigger a restart. |
